question: How many wild poliovirus cases did Pakistan and Afghanistan report in 2025?
text: In 2025, Pakistan reported **31 cases** of wild poliovirus type 1 (WPV1), and Afghanistan reported **21 cases**, for a combined total of **52**. ([who.int](https://www.who.int/vanuatu/news/detail-global/13-11-2026-statement-of-the-forty-sixth-meeting-of-the-polio-ihr-emergency-committee?utm_source=openai))
